content.json:
# XdrLogRaider — Connector Ops Dashboard

**What this dashboard shows:** Operator-facing operations view focused on connector throughput + reliability + cost trends. Complements `XdrLogRaider_ConnectorHealth` (binary health checks) with VELOCITY + DEPTH + RATE telemetry SOC operators need for capacity planning + incident triage.

**Use cases:**
- **Capacity planning**: ingestion velocity per stream + per category + per cadence tier; baseline drift + spike detection
- **DLQ triage**: depth + age + per-stream replay status; identify backed-up streams before SLA breach
- **Auth chain reliability**: retry storms + AADSTS error class breakdown + circuit-breaker telemetry
- **Stream health velocity**: row-rate trending per SourceName; identify gradually-dying streams BEFORE they go fully dry
- **Rate-limit detection**: 429 storms by host with Retry-After distribution
- **Cold-start tracking**: Function App restart cadence + first-row latency
- **Cost optimization**: row volume per stream-tier; identify streams violating cost-budget

**Panels:**
1. Ingestion velocity per category — last 24h time-series (rows/min)
2. DLQ depth + oldest-entry age trending
3. Auth chain failure breakdown (AADSTS code histogram + retry distribution)
4. Stream-level health velocity matrix (rows/hour delta vs prior-period baseline)
5. Rate-limit (429) storm chart per host
6. Function App invocation success rate (Xdr-Refresh + Xdr-PollOrchestrator + Xdr-PollStream + Connector-Heartbeat)
7. Per-stream Hot-Fix 7 truncation events (Ingest.RowTruncated)
8. Cost-budget gate trip events (XdrOps-RowVolumeSpike)

**Data sources:** `AppRequests` + `AppDependencies` + `AppExceptions` + `AppEvents` + `AppMetrics` + `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` + 10 `Defender_<Category>_CL` workspace tables.

**Hot-Fix 17 NEW (2026-05-10)**: created to address operator pain point — connector observability beyond binary 'Connected/Disconnected'. References Hot-Fix 7 truncation telemetry, Hot-Fix 6 single-value graphQuery, Hot-Fix 8 storage 409 suppression, Hot-Fix 5 drift parser cardinality.
## 1. Ingestion velocity per category — last 24h time-series

content.query:
union
    (Defender_ActionCenter_CL              | extend Category='ActionCenter'),
    (Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL  | extend Category='ConfigurationAndSettings'),
    (Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL     | extend Category='EndpointConfiguration'),
    (Defender_EndpointDeviceManagement_CL  | extend Category='EndpointDeviceManagement'),
    (Defender_ExposureManagement_CL        | extend Category='ExposureManagement'),
    (Defender_IdentityProtection_CL        | extend Category='IdentityProtection'),
    (Defender_MultiTenantOperations_CL     | extend Category='MultiTenantOperations'),
    (Defender_StreamingApi_CL              | extend Category='StreamingApi'),
    (Defender_ThreatAnalytics_CL           | extend Category='ThreatAnalytics'),
    (Defender_VulnerabilityManagement_CL   | extend Category='VulnerabilityManagement')
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Rows = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Category
| render timechart
content.title: Ingestion velocity per category (rows/15min)

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name in ('xdr.dlq.depth', 'xdr.dlq.oldest_age_minutes')
| summarize Value = max(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Name
| render timechart
content.title: DLQ depth + oldest-entry age (5min bins)

content.json: ## 3. Auth chain failure breakdown (AADSTS code histogram)

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Properties contains 'AuthChain' or ProblemId contains 'AADSTS' or Message contains 'AADSTS'
| extend AADSTSCode = tostring(Properties.AADSTSCode)
| extend Stage = tostring(Properties.Stage)
| summarize FailureCount = count(), Streams = make_set(tostring(Properties.Stream), 30) by AADSTSCode, Stage
| order by FailureCount desc
content.title: Auth chain failures (AADSTS code x Stage breakdown)

content.query:
let now_count = union
    Defender_ActionCenter_CL, Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL,
    Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL, Defender_EndpointDeviceManagement_CL,
    Defender_ExposureManagement_CL, Defender_IdentityProtection_CL,
    Defender_MultiTenantOperations_CL, Defender_StreamingApi_CL,
    Defender_ThreatAnalytics_CL, Defender_VulnerabilityManagement_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | summarize NowRows = count() by SourceName;
let prev_count = union
    Defender_ActionCenter_CL, Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL,
    Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL, Defender_EndpointDeviceManagement_CL,
    Defender_ExposureManagement_CL, Defender_IdentityProtection_CL,
    Defender_MultiTenantOperations_CL, Defender_StreamingApi_CL,
    Defender_ThreatAnalytics_CL, Defender_VulnerabilityManagement_CL
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(48h) .. ago(24h))
    | summarize PrevRows = count() by SourceName;
now_count
| join kind=fullouter prev_count on SourceName
| extend Stream = coalesce(SourceName, SourceName1)
| extend NowRows = coalesce(NowRows, 0)
| extend PrevRows = coalesce(PrevRows, 0)
| extend DeltaPct = case(
    PrevRows == 0 and NowRows > 0, 100.0,
    PrevRows == 0 and NowRows == 0, 0.0,
    round((NowRows - PrevRows) * 100.0 / PrevRows, 1))
| extend Trend = case(
    DeltaPct > 200, '🔥 Spike',
    DeltaPct > 20, '📈 Up',
    DeltaPct < -50, '⚠️ Drop',
    DeltaPct < -20, '📉 Down',
    'Stable')
| project Stream, NowRows, PrevRows, DeltaPct, Trend
| order by abs(DeltaPct) desc
content.title: Stream health velocity (24h current vs prior-24h baseline)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultCode == '429'
| extend Host = tostring(split(Target, '/')[2])
| summarize Count429 = count(), AvgRetryAfter = avg(toint(tostring(Properties.RetryAfter))) by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), Host
| render timechart
content.title: 429 storms per host (30min bins)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name in ('Xdr-Refresh', 'Xdr-PollOrchestrator', 'Xdr-PollStream', 'Connector-Heartbeat')
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Succ = countif(Success),
    Fail = countif(!Success),
    P50_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    P99_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 99)
    by Name
| extend SuccessRate = round(Succ * 100.0 / Total, 2)
| order by Name asc
content.title: FA invocation health (success rate + latency percentiles)

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == 'Ingest.RowTruncated'
| extend Stream = tostring(Properties.Stream)
| extend OriginalBytes = toint(Properties.OriginalBytes)
| summarize
    TruncationEvents = count(),
    AvgOriginalBytes = avg(OriginalBytes),
    MaxOriginalBytes = max(OriginalBytes)
    by Stream
| order by TruncationEvents desc
content.title: Hot-Fix 7 row-size truncation events per stream (was: silent skip + data loss)

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name in ('Ingest.RowDroppedAfterTruncate', 'Stream.RowVolumeSpike', 'Stream.CostBudgetTrip')
| extend Stream = tostring(Properties.Stream)
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Name, Stream
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Cost-budget gate trips (RowVolumeSpike + RowDroppedAfterTruncate + CostBudgetTrip)
